title: Kentucky Board of Tax Appeals — Final Order Republic National Distributing Company (26-R-002)
text:
COMMONWEALTH OF KENTUCKY
OFFICE OF CLAIMS AND APPEALS
BOARD OF TAX APPEALS
APPEAL NO. K26-R-002

REPUBLIC NATIONAL DiSTRIBUTION CO. APPELLANT
Vv. ORDER _DISMISSING

FINANCE & ADMINISTRATION CABINET
DEPARTMENT OF REVENUE APPELLEE

HEISE EE SHEE IHS SEI ebb

This matter has been pending with the Board since the filing of the Petition of Appeal
by the Appellant on or about January 14, 2026. The Appellant was thereafter notified that the
Petition as filed was deficient and was given a reasonable time to bring the Petition into compliance. At the
passage of that time with no response from the Appellant. this Board entered an Order to Show Cause
why this matter should not be dismissed for failure to bring the Petition into compliance with the
statutes and regulations. No timely response was received to the Show Cause Order.

Based on the foregoing, and being otherwise sufficiently advised. the matter is HEREBY

DISMISSED. if

SO ORDERED this the Alb day of March, 2026.
